1283-1651-6441-6753-8276.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Hive by paying {5} and tapping it, creating four 1/1 Wasp artifact creature tokens due to Exalted Sunborn and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping the Wasps, untapping Chromatic Orrery and The Hive.
Repeat.
1283-1651-6441-6753-8276.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

1329-3363-6797.easyPrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-3363-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing The One Ring, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast The One Ring from your graveyard this turn.
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

1456-3499-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

728-5805--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
728-5805--5.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat

277-4094-4772-6753-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-4094-4772-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

2653-2893-5478-7906.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Thranduil's Company trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Thranduil's Company trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

676-3259-7296.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
676-3259-7296.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Magnus the Red, triggering Breath of Fury and Magnus the Red.
Resolve the Magnus the Red trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2946-4871-5147-6026.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5147-6026.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2043-2921-3621.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the token Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

4968-6996.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Deathbringer Thoctar lifelink.
4968-6996.description:
Give Deathbringer Thoctar lifelink.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat.

457-1458-4404-6289.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-4404-6289.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Voyager Quickwelder.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

413-3175-4775.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2793-3743-5089-6753-7178.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-5089-6753-7178.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

104-851-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-851-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

3713-5078-5268-5741.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1003-2438-5220-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

339-677-1849-2292.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5223-6575-6684.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of The First Tyrannic War and then putting two lore counters on it.
The First Tyrannic War token's first, second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger. Then, resolve the second trigger, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the third First Tyrannic War trigger, putting two lore counters on Esper Terra and causing you to sacrifice the First Tyrannic War token.
Esper Terra's third and fourth chapter abilities trigger. Resolve the third ability's trigger, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a memory counter on it

3951-5703-6645-6646.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr or Gogo.
3951-5703-6645-6646.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Gogo triggers, causing it to become a copy of Altaïr with its name not changing, and causing both Gogo and Altaïr to get +2/+0 and haste until end of turn.
Declare Gogo and Altaïr as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the Gogo trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three lore counters on it

112-1283-3075-6577.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three experience counters
112-1283-3075-6577.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Summon: Esper Valigarmanda triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its fourth chapter ability.
Holding priority, cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {1}, removing a lore counter from Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Resolve the Summon: Esper Valigarmanda ability, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {1}, putting a lore counter on Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Summon: Esper Valigarmanda's fourth chapter ability triggers.
Repeat from step 2.

341-1020-2866-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

719-1789-5256-5649.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
719-1789-5256-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

913-2423-2440-4183.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Bounding Krasis
913-2423-2440-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Bounding Krasis with haste.
When the token Bounding Krasis enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Bounding Krasis trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Bounding Krasis, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Bounding Krasis for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

112-1170-6203.manaNeeded: {3}{U} if Throne of Eldraine's chosen color is not "Blue"
112-1170-6203.description:
If able, activate Throne of Eldraine's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast blue monocolored spells.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Displacer Kitten.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Throne of Eldraine. Choose "Blue" as it enters the battlefield.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

864-2080-4050.notablePrerequisites: The number of nontoken creatures you control plus the number of creature cards in all graveyards is at least nine.
864-2080-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 for each other nontoken creature you control.
Cast Rise of the Dark Realms by paying {7}{B}{B}, returning all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rise of the Dark Realms to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2060-4222-5296-5462.manaNeeded: {7} available plus an additional {1} if you have no colored mana
2060-4222-5296-5462.notablePrerequisites: Raucous Entertainer does not have summoning sickness.
2060-4222-5296-5462.description:
Cast Workhorse by paying {6}.
Activate Workhorse three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Cast Crystalline Crawler by paying {4}, using at least one colored mana if available.
If Crystalline Crawler has a +1/+1 counter on it, activate its first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Activate Raucous Entertainer by paying {1} and tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler, Workhorse and any other creature you control the entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Raucous Entertainer.
Repeat from step 5.

2034-3345-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Imperious Oligarch, adding {C}{C}.
When Imperious Oligarch dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Imperious Oligarch trigger, creating a creature token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Imperious Oligarch from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

1201-1651-3661-5270.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
When Shield Sphere enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating a Food artifact token.
If desired, you may activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Food and Shield Sphere, untapping any artifact.
Activate Witch's Oven by tapping it and sacrificing Shield Sphere, creating two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Foods, untapping Witch's Oven.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing three Foods, returning Shield Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

579-4289-4824.notablePrerequisites: Soliton does not have summoning sickness.
579-4289-4824.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

225-539-1257-3257.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Walking Atlas as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

168-4753-4768-4948.description:
Cast Estrid's Invocation by paying {2}{U}.
Estrid's Invocation enters the battlefield, triggering Altar of the Brood and itself.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Estrid's Invocation's trigger, becoming a copy of Oblivion Ring and exiling Oblivion Ring.
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Clever Impersonator enters the battlefield, triggering Altar of the Brood and itself.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator's trigger, becoming a copy of Estrid's Invocation and exiling Estrid's Invocation.
Estrid's Invocation leaves the battlefield, returning Oblivion Ring from exile to the battlefield.
Altar of the Brood and Oblivion Ring triggers.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Oblivion Ring's trigger, exiling Clever Impersonator.
Clever Impersonator leaves the battlefield, returning Estrid's Invocation from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
